title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Psalms 28: a call to Yahweh not to be silent, the fate of the workers of iniquity, and Yahweh as strength, shield and shepherd.

questions.text: What does the psalmist call Yahweh in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 28:1 says, 'To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don't be deaf to me.'

questions.text: If Yahweh is silent, whom does the psalmist fear he would become like?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he would become like those who go down into the pit.

answers.text: A tree that has no water
Those who go down into the pit
A lost sheep in the desert
Dust blown away by the wind

questions.text: Toward what does the psalmist lift up his hands?
questions.explanation: Psalms 28:2 says, 'when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.'

questions.text: According to what does the psalmist ask Yahweh to give the wicked?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings.'

answers.text: The mercy he shows to all

questions.text: Because they do not respect Yahweh's works, what will he do to them?
questions.explanation: Psalms 28:5 says he will break them down and not build them up.

answers.text: Break them down and not build them up
Give them more time to repent

questions.text: Why does the psalmist say, 'Blessed be Yahweh'?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, 'Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.'

answers.text: He has given him a son and heir
He has defeated all the nations
He has filled his barns with grain
He has heard the voice of his petitions

questions.text: Besides his strength, what does the psalmist call Yahweh in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 28:7 says, 'Yahweh is my strength and my shield.'

questions.text: What will the psalmist do with his song?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, 'With my song I will thank him.'

questions.text: To whom is Yahweh a stronghold of salvation?
questions.explanation: Psalms 28:8 says, 'He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.'

questions.text: What does the last verse ask Yahweh to be to his people?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, 'Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also.'
